description: DVWDesign canonical Renovate preset for PUBLIC repos — mirrors RootDispatcher/config/renovate-base.json (the private-repo source of truth). Consume via: "extends": ["github>DESIGN-DVW/renovate-config"]. Kept in sync by hand — see DISPATCH-094. CADENCE (2026-11-11): consumers run Wednesday, whole day, and take releases at least 7 days old; shared-packages runs every other day at 3 days, so it adopts first. Never narrow a window below a whole day (the 'before 9am on Monday' window starved queues for weeks). DELIBERATE DIFFERENCE from the private preset: NO automerge lane here yet. The private preset's v3.0 safe class needs a required CI check on the consumer's default branch (DISPATCH-140); this preset's consumer (DocuMind) has none, and GitHub auto-merge would merge untested. Port the safe-class rules here only once every consumer of this preset requires CI.

packageRules.description: Internal @design-dvw/* are private GitHub Packages governed by the shared-packages release + consumer-registry flow (shared-packages-first) — NOT by Renovate. Disabling avoids private-registry 'no-result' lookup failures (the Renovate bot has no read:packages auth). Security of these packages is managed at the shared-packages source; see DEPENDENCY-GOVERNANCE.md › Internal packages.

Group all Storybook packages so they move together in ONE PR (they must stay on the same version). Storybook version alignment follows shared-packages (Main) — see docs/ecosystem/DEPENDENCY-GOVERNANCE.md.

NO AUTOMERGE, ANY update type. Policy: every dependency change lands through a reviewed PR — there is no unattended merge lane in this ecosystem (operator decision 2026-07-26; see DEPENDENCY-GOVERNANCE.md › Merge policy and DECISION-RIGHTS.md). Staleness is handled by the PR-age watchdog that warns the operator, NOT by automerging. This rule is deliberately last so it overrides any automerge inherited from config:recommended.
Major version bumps are additionally labelled so the watchdog and reviewers can triage them first (human-gated per DECISION-RIGHTS.md)

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Renovate does NOT open security PRs. Dependabot owns security updates (org-enforced via DESIGN-DVW-org-config-1); this avoids duplicate security PRs. Renovate handles routine version updates only. See docs/ecosystem/DEPENDENCY-GOVERNANCE.md.
